SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income_amount, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_total_income
FROM income AS i
JOIN member AS mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id
JOIN major AS m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
GROUP BY m.college;
